content.title: Welcome to the Mile High City - City and County of Denver
content.text: Skip to main content opens in new tab or window Welcome to the Mile High City A beautiful, bustling metropolis set against the backdrop of the Rocky Mountains, Denver is widely recognized for its exceptional balance of a thriving economy, healthy lifestyle, and urban as well as natural amenities. This urban enclave offers exciting opportunities for both corporate employers as well as entrepreneurs, award-winning transit and mobility, and excellence in education and health care--all set against a legendary backdrop for leisure and recreation. Denver is strengthening its reputation as one of America’s most livable cities. As a destination that simply “has it all,” Denver more than ever is a top choice to live, work and enjoy life. We invite you to explore further and see why! Global Business Development As a regional and national business center for both private and public organizations in the United States, the Mile High City has become one of the most important communication, transportation and distribution hubs regionally, nationally and globally. Workforce Talent Denver's is second to none in concentrated talent. Our workforce strength is created when you start from a place with an exceptionally well-educated population, and then overlay the fact that this is a top-ranking place where people all over the country would choose to live. Retail Development Interested in expanding your retail operations in Denver? We provide key information that will help your company make the decision.
